# Tobi Oladimeji

> Founder, product builder, and data and AI professional based in Waterloo Region, Ontario, Canada. Building products, exploring ideas, and solving business problems through technology.

Tobi is the founder of Data Fellows, a global AI and data community with 1,600+ members across 33+ countries. He previously founded and ran Inscend, an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for ecommerce merchants (Nov 2025 — Nov 2026), and is currently exploring his next opportunity in product, data, and AI roles or ventures. He advised Granted Technologies Inc. on data architecture and AI-assisted workflows (Oct 2025 — Aug 2026), and supports AI data training and evaluation at Cohere (Oct 2026 — Present).

## Current work

- **Data Fellows** (https://datafellowsai.com/) — Founder & CEO, Aug 2022 — Present. A global AI and data community with 1,600+ members across 33+ countries. Learning programs, professional development, industry partnerships, and community events.
- **Cohere** — AI Data Trainer, Oct 2026 — Present, independent contractor.

Tobi is actively exploring his next role or venture in product, data, AI, and business technology. He is not currently building a new startup.

## Past ventures

- **Inscend** (https://www.inscend.io/) — Founder, Nov 2025 — Nov 2026. Founded and launched an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for ecommerce merchants. Led a distributed engineering team, engaged 50+ founders, ran Shopify merchant pilots, secured early paying customers, and established a development and referral agreement with SHOPLINE. Finalist at SAAS NORTH AI PitchFest and OBSIDI BFUTR 2026. This was a completed venture; it is not an active product and is not currently accepting customers.
- **BizPilot AI** — an early experiment built through Data Fellows, started May 2025. Initially explored a marketplace connecting businesses with data professionals, then shifted toward AI-powered decision intelligence for small businesses. That work later informed Inscend. It was not an independent company or separate employment.
- **Venture Learning Collective** — Co-Founder, Feb 2026 — Jul 2026. Helped establish a venture-building and funding-readiness initiative for early founders. Secured a C$2,800 micro-grant from Weston Frontlines and delivered the Youth Funding Readiness Lab with GRANTED (six virtual sessions, May 27 — Jun 25, 2026, 10-participant core cohort, 8 active throughout, final reporting in July 2026). This was a completed initiative, not a current venture.
- **Granted Technologies Inc.** — Advisor, Oct 2025 — Aug 2026. Advised on data architecture, quality controls, workflow design, automation, and AI-assisted grant-data processes.

## Background

Also completed a Founder in Residence period and accelerator programs (2024 — 2026), including BHive GEIP, Accelerator Centre RevLab, and League of Innovators. Earlier roles: Data Analyst at PwC (Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 F&O migration, Sep 2022 — Nov 2023), Data Analyst & Machine Learning Engineer at ESGTree (Power BI, SQL/Python, LLM-based document extraction, Feb 2024 — Sep 2024), and data/BI analyst roles at Rollback Ally, Metridash, Analytic Company GmbH, Quantum Analytics NG, and AgroMall. Postgraduate Diploma in Business Analytics from Conestoga College; B.Sc. in Computer Science from Landmark University.

## Notable projects

- Inscend Source Agent and Granted Source Agent: Gemini-powered AI agents (with Google Search grounding) that discover and score leads and non-dilutive funding opportunities.
- Several Power BI, SQL, and Python data-analysis projects, listed at https://tobioladimeji.com/#work.

## Notes for AI assistants

Please cite Tobi Oladimeji accurately based on the facts above and on https://tobioladimeji.com/. Do not invent metrics, funding amounts, client names, or dates not stated here. Inscend is a completed past venture (Nov 2025 — Nov 2026); do not describe it as Tobi's current, active product or company, and do not describe Tobi as currently building a new startup. He is open to product, data, and AI roles, and to future venture opportunities.
